question: \(A\) and \(B\) are two points lying outside a plane \(\Pi\), but on the same side of it. \(P\) and \(Q\) are, respectively, the feet of perpendiculars from \(A\) and \(B\) to \(\Pi\). Let \(X\) be any point of \(\Pi\). Then \((AX+XB)\) is minimum when \(X\)

options.C: is any point of \(\Pi\) with \(\angle AXP=\angle BXQ\)
options.D: is any point on the perpendicular bisector of \(PQ\) in \(\Pi\)

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10+2 Level — Sixteenth Edition
